scope: Read-only evidence reconciliation for #technologiak. No WordPress, global CSS, plugin, shared resource, source-site or browser mutation.
proven: The three technology cards are source-aligned in visible heading/copy/order.
Existing target generated icon badges are present and align in subject/order with the source cards.
The prepared visual package intentionally does not write article::before or article::after because those pseudos are current icon owners.

Known technology visual deltas are card padding/radius/shadow/sage hairline/watermark, section lead/eyebrow treatment and checklist marker/callout presentation; prepared page256-local visual rules cover those independently.
not_proven: No repository evidence establishes pixel-exact icon-badge geometry, path data, stroke/shape, rotation or per-card placement against the source.
The phrase 'align in subject/order' is not a pixel-exactness proof.
No raw immutable source HTML/CSS snapshot containing the exact icon badge SVG/path is currently versioned in the repository.

decision.preserve: Do not replace, suppress or restyle the current technology article icon pseudo-elements from static evidence alone.
decision.reason: A blind icon replacement could regress an already source-aligned owner; exact source geometry must be observed first.
decision.hard_blocker_effect: Do not increase or clear the authoritative hard-blocker count from this audit alone. Keep PIXEL_PASS=false until live visual acceptance covers the icon badges.

next_live_proof: Reuse only the existing source/target Opera pair when browser ownership returns; open no diagnostic tabs.
At the same desktop viewport/DPR/zoom, capture or inspect a tight #technologiak card-icon comparison rather than another full-page capture.
Confirm badge box size, leaf/icon shape, orientation, color and offset for all three cards.
If visually exact, mark the icon owner PASS_PRESERVE and leave the pseudos untouched.
If a concrete geometry delta is reproduced, recover the source rule/path first and prepare the smallest page256-local override; never infer SVG geometry from memory or card subject.
